payload.prompt: Do these steps in order, one tool call each, and do not skip any: (1) Read pkg/big.py with no offset or limit. (2) Read pkg/big.py with offset 100 and limit 20. (3) Grep for 'def add' in the repo with output_mode content. (4) Glob for '**/*.py'. (5) Run with Bash: python -m pytest tests/test_mul.py -q. (6) Run with Bash: python -m pytest tests/test_add.py -q. (7) Read pkg/calc.py then Edit it so add returns a + b. (8) Write a new file notes.txt containing 'done'. (9) Run with Bash: python -c "print('x'*200000)". (10) Run with Bash: python -m pytest -q. Then reply with one word: finished.
